business_problem: As adversaries use AI to scale attacks and exploit vulnerabilities faster, Cisco needs to correlate network signals and investigate, patch, and remediate threats across distributed enterprise infrastructure at machine speed.
solution_summary: Cisco combines network telemetry with OpenAI models to correlate signals that may look benign individually and surface patterns for security operations. The page describes controls distributed across microservices, containers and Kubernetes clusters: application-level policies restrict each service to necessary connections, while selective isolation can contain affected systems without stopping unaffected services. The AI capabilities are intended to help teams investigate threats, identify and patch vulnerabilities, and shorten response and remediation; Daybreak and GPT-6 Astra are cited as advances. The capabilities are designed to fit existing scanning workflows rather than require teams to replace their processes. The story does not name a telemetry-ingestion pipeline, model-serving architecture, storage layer, or specific scanning products, so those implementation details cannot be specified.
